title: CatalogItemReference
description: A reference to a catalog item within a catalog page.

@id.description: The URL to fetch the catalog item.

@type.description: The type of the catalog item. Either nuget:PackageDetails or nuget:PackageDelete.

commitId.description: The commit ID associated with this catalog item.

commitTimeStamp.description: The commit timestamp of this catalog item.

nuget:id.description: The package ID that this item is related to.

nuget:version.description: The package version that this item is related to.
